title: Browser Network Interception & HAR Replay
description: Trace how CDP/Service Worker interception captures a real fetch() and replays a recorded HAR stream.

steps.label: 1. Browser Dispatches Real Request
steps.description: App calls fetch('/api/v2/cart'); browser attaches cookies, origin headers, and aborts signals.

steps.label: 2. Match Entry in HAR Index
steps.description: Interceptor pauses the request and matches method + URL against the recorded HAR file.

steps.label: 3. Fulfill Response & Stream Body
steps.description: Interceptor returns the archived headers and ReadableStream body back through browser decoding.
steps.codeHighlight: const data = await res.json(); // Parsed via real Response stream
